programme.title: Fudbal - Španska liga: Valencia - Real Madrid 07.11.
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Košarka - Liga prvaka: Spartak - Cholet
programme.desc: Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina Basketball Champions League. Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji Euroleague Basketball S.L. i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Basketball - Eurocup: Siauliai - Tenerife
programme.desc: Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second competition of Euroleague Basketball. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to qualify for the Euroleague compete in this competition, and mostly clubs from the top 15 strongest European leagues participate in it. Placement in the Eurocup is secured through national championships and cups, and through invitations to the so-called wildcards. The second strongest competition in European basketball was created by the merger of the FIBA ​​Radivoje Korać Cup and the Saporta Cup. The significance of this competition is that the winner secures the right to participate in the next season in the strongest club basketball competition in Europe, the Euroleague.

programme.title: Giroud: The 40th birthday dinner
programme.desc: Quoi de mieux que d'être entouré de ses proches pour passer le cap de la quarantaine ? Canal+ a décidé de célébrer l'anniversaire d'Olivier Giroud en réunissant autour de lui ses amis. Dans un restaurant lillois, l'attaquant champion du monde a dîné en compagnie des consultants Christophe Jallet et Robert Pirès, mais également de son ami, l'ancien international Mathieu Debuchy. Pendant plus d'une heure, l'ancien buteur des Bleus se livre comme rarement : sa future reconversion, les critiques sur son parcours, les transferts manqués, les treize ans à l'étranger, l'armoire à trophées. Sans oublier des messages d'anniversaire surprises d'anciens coéquipiers, des anecdotes décalées sur sa riche carrière et les bougies soufflées !

programme.title: Sports interior
programme.desc: Nager 1,6 km en maillot de bain, dans une eau à moins de 5 degrés, dans les étendues glacées d'Arctique : c'est le défi que Marion Joffle s'est lancé en 2022 ! Après une première tentative stoppée à 50 mètres de l'arrivée, en hypothermie et à la limite de la noyade, la Normande de 27 ans part retenter sa chance quatre ans plus tard, malgré le traumatisme. Une aventure hors norme où chaque mouvement peut être le dernier. Un reportage d'Antoine Huguet et Quentin Monaton.

Longtemps réservée à l'élite du surf mondial, elle est aujourd'hui apprivoisée par une nouvelle génération de surfeurs locaux, dont Kelia Galina, Gilbert Teave et Tahurai Henry. programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: A framed kung-fu master seeks revenge after 15 years in prison. He survives one attempt on his life after another! An intriguing, exciting production which weaves mystery and suspense with kung-fu action.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: David is falling in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming. Out of jealousy, Mona lies to him about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: It's tale of brave knights, chivalry and fair maidens where the Swift Knight finds himself involved in romance, court intrigue and deadly jousts while trying to protect a baby who is the Emperor's secret heir apparent.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: In the waning day of the Ching Dynasty, the son of the local magistrate murdered a peddler and raped his wife. The wife had been framed for her husband's murder by the rapist.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful young fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealousy and a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang-lung both work as guards for the Tien Ying Treasury House, an establishment that offers its clients storage and safe transportation for their money or valuables.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace.

programme.title: Melody Of Love
programme.desc: This delightful romance story tells the story of three doctors pursuing three beauties who play hard-to-get in the 'a-go-go' era of the 70s.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng flees to San Francisco after he is framed for drug possession. He assists Philip Kwok's notorious White Dragons in a vicious gang war, only to then be betrayed.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: The Shepherd Girl, a heartwarming 1963 musical from Shaw Brothers! In this musical drama, Julie Yeh Feng stars as Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl who falls in love with a handsome boatman named Liu Ta-lung

programme.title: Danger Has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: An amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry from Li Han Hsiang, recreating some of the era's funniest and most surreal stories ripped straight from the gossip.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: There is an old grudge between families among the Ching and Ming supporters in Kwang Tung. Some years later, Liang's son Hsiao-hu returns to avenge his father's death.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei stars as a young singer, Hsiao-Yun, struggles between her success in career and her relationship with her pianist lover Li Yen-nan.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Acclaimed actor Danny Lee plays a motorbike workshop owner who injured during an illegal motorcycle race and continues to race regardless of the physical consequences and the law.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: A dedicated wife uncovers a web of blackmail and deceit after her husband is conned by a conniving belly dancer. When the dancer is stabbed, things quickly go from bad to insane.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: This is a tragic tale about a young girl, played by Ivy Ling Po, who gets married and has five kids. She and her husband later die, forcing one child to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: The Kung-Fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: Humiliated swordsman Chin Wu-hsin is charged with finding the Supreme Sword of Old Eagle, only to retrieve it using foul play. This leads Old Eagle's own son to avenge his father.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Lo Wei helms this poetic romance that proves a perfect showcase for Ivy Ling Po's incredible talents, as a young scholar manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Martial arts legend Chan Koon Tai plays a city gang leader, who runs his operation out of a local cafe in this gritty, crime drama from director Kuei Chih Hung.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. The union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: With the destruction of the Shaolin Temple, five students must each learn Shaolin techniques in order to defeat their Ching adversaries. But there's a ''traitor'' amongst them, but who is it?

programme.title: Sex, Love And Hate
programme.desc: In Sex, Love And Hate, director of erotica and kung-fu films Chu Yuan combines stars from both genres to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from it.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: The evil minister uses the twelve golden medallions, the highest imperial decree, to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Ti Lung who lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with his brothers the Black Snake and the Yellow Snake, have been trying to turn into humans for a thousand years.

programme.title: All Men Are Brothers
programme.desc: The patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: Shaw Bros and TVB stars unite for Wang Feng's ensemble epic. Trouble is brewing when a gangster plans to change the Gossip Street residents' favourite hangout into a gambling den.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Set on the eve of the Japanese invasion of HK, this tragic Shaw Brothers romance stars Li Ting and Kwan Shan as young lovers torn apart by war.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and she confronts him when she finds herself pregnant.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Lily Ho portrays the feared swordswoman Silver Fox, who witnessed her father senselessly wounded and her mother raped. 18 years later it's payback time.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs to teach her martial arts skills.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and taking revenge.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Hsiao Fang is a young girl not afraid to fight back against hooligans. Unfortunately, she mistakes the handsome Ma Ta-hai, for one such hoodlum. The two are immediately attracted but refuse to admit their true feelings.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Another film inspired by the Chinese classic tale Journey to the West. This memorable version presents a unique interpretation with humour, action, and fantasy galore.

programme.title: Shark Busters (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Hit by a media storm over his own mounting debts, a police officer leads an investigation against the loan sharks behind a sinister credit scheme.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: In 1920s China, a bandit arrives in a remote provincial town posing as its new mayor, where he faces off against a tyrannical local nobleman.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: A Hong Kong taxi driver's life horribly falls apart after accidentally hitting a sorcerer with his cab. He decides to seek the sorcerer's help to turn the curse on his enemies at the expense of his own life.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Brilliant director Sun Chung and the majestic Ti Lung reunite for a thriller about an aging fighter who relives his violent past mistakes through a streetwise kid.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. Things change, when Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man at Tamotsu's funeral.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: A dutiful cop, guilt-ridden over saving the life of a gang leader, becomes obsessed with bringing down the crime syndicate of the man he saved.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Grave robbers unearth preserved vampires. Transporting child vampire, its spell breaks, befriending locals. Parent vampires awaken, escape. Herbalist pursues to destroy them.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop.

programme.title: Look For A Star
programme.desc: Inspired by the relationship between Stanly Ho and his fourth wife, Angela, it's a romantic comedy about a billonaire who falls in love with a feisty casino dealer.

programme.title: The Grandmaster (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Ip Man takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond.

programme.title: The Sorcerer And The White Snake
programme.desc: A master monk tries to protect a naive young physician from a thousand-year-old snake demon. A contest of psychic powers results in mayhem.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: The young emperor Kangxi is attempting to select a bride. His mother has arranged for young available women to visit him so that he may choose.

programme.title: Final Justice
programme.desc: A cop relies on a young car thief to take down four gangsters, who plan to rob a rich merchant for a large amount of money.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition, he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Ming is a mole in the police department and Yan is a police mole in the Triads. Leading parallel lives, Ming and Yan are feeling increasingly trapped in their false surroundings and they're desperate to find a way out.

programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Three lotharios vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School, an extremely non-monastic institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Get In The Dark
programme.desc: Miss Qiao had died in vain and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge and a series of horrible events begins to happen.

programme.title: How To Pick Girls Up!
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective suffers a fatal accident involving a mysterious medallion and is transformed into an immortal warrior with superhuman powers.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Never take your mistress on an annual guys' getaway, especially one devoted to hunting - a violent lesson for three wealthy married men.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: The whole school is held hostage during the day of an English speech competition. As Ip Man decides to step up and rise to the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: A failed assassination attempt in Harbin, China in 1909 changes the course of history. Now two JBI agents must find the connections between it and an ancient Korean artifact.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: This refreshing musical comedy tempers its fizzy charm with just enough tartness to insure its charming buoyancy. This light look at teenage life even won starlet Chou Hsiu-lan a Hong Kong Film Awards nomination for Best Newcomer.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Action superstar Chow Yun-Fat portrays real-life gangster Chen Daqi as he rises to the upper echelons of power, finding himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3
programme.desc: A Taoist priest and his spirit companions must go separate ways after he decides to help a vampire-buster, who wants to defeat an evil witch and her henchmen.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: An imperial agent gets ridiculed for his various inventions, until his supportive wife encourages him to attend a conference, which's actually a trap to kill all the doctors serving the emperor, where his crazy inventions come in handy.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: When a young man ignores a feng shui master's warning and decides to marry before turning 30, a series of mishaps begins to curse his life.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: At a Hong Kong shopping center, Buck Yuen's (Jackie Chan's) intuition warns him. He saves a robbery's loot and gets on television, ends up in Istanbul via South Korea, and accidentally becomes a spy. Fortunately, he knows Kung Fu.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: A fantasy-horror set in present-day Moscow where the respective forces that control daytime and nighttime do battle.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The documentary highlights renowned Chinese Kung Fu masters in the film industry, showcasing Hong Kong's Kung Fu legacy over sixty years and capturing their daring lives.

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: A supernatural mystery film with a detective investigating murders that seem to be the result of a curse.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 3
programme.desc: Police officer Chow Sing Sing is assigned to work undercover investigating the murder of millionaire Million Wong, to whom Chow has an uncanny resemblance, by posing as an amnesiac Wong.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After ambushing and killing his rival, losing everything in the process, dispirited warlord Hou Jie turns to a Shaolin monastery seeking salvation.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his older brother Ma Tai Chueng arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Be-friending a powerful mobster Wing Jing is given his nightclub in return for saving Tam Sei’s life. Unfortunately, another Gangster wants the territory a well.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic girl travels to Hong Kong in search of certain love but instead meets a kind-hearted professional fighter for whom she begins to fall instead.

programme.title: Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink : PL Moments
programme.desc: Over a nine season spell in the Premier League, Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink etched his name into footballing folklore as one of the most dynamic goalscorers in the competition's history. Fourth all time in Premier League goals for Chelsea, Hasselbaink's iconic freekicks and powerful finishes have seen him score some of the League's most memorable goals. This week, the Dutch international sits down with PL Moments to break down how to strike the ball, and talk us through his ten favourite moments from his Premier League career.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). programme.title: Dramatyczne rzuty karne
programme.desc: Rzuty karne w piłce nożnej to ogromne emocje towarzyszące zarówno biorącym w nich udział piłkarzom, jak i obserwującym je kibicom. Szczęście, nerwy ze stali i umiejętności techniczne są potrzebne, by dobrze wykonywać rzuty karne. Umiejętność ta jest bardzo ważna, bo strzały z jedenastu metrów rozstrzygały o losach niejednego ważnego spotkania.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Venezia FC - Udinese Calcio

programme.title: Najlepsi napastnicy Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Stefan Kuntz, Mario Basler, Fredi Bobic, Ulf Kirsten, Toni Polster i wielu innych zachwycało kibiców swoimi umiejętnościami na boiskach Bundesligi w latach 90. ubiegłego stulecia. W programie przyjrzymy się sylwetkom łowców bramek i oczywiście najpiękniejszym golom w ich bogatych kolekcjach.

programme.title: HHH - Hamburger SV
programme.desc: Widzowie zobaczą historię jednego z najważniejszych zespołów niemieckiej piłki. Hamburger SV sześć razy zdobywał tytuł mistrza Niemiec. Aktualnie drużyna gra w 2. Bundeslidze i stara się wrócić do elity niemieckiej piłki klubowej.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole Borussii Dortmund
programme.desc: Michael Zorc, Stéphane Chapuisat, Robert Lewandowski, Andreas Moller to tylko niektórzy spośród piłkarzy Borussii Dortmund, którzy potrafili zdobywać bramki w zadziwiający sposób. W programie widzowie zobaczą najładniejsze gole w wykonaniu zawodników BVB.

programme.title: Birds of paradise
programme.desc: Filmowcy i dziennikarze zebrali w jednym miejscu ciekawostki dotyczące Bundesligi. Każdy znajdzie w tym filmie coś dla siebie, niemiecka liga bowiem to nie tylko sport, ale ogromne przedsięwzięcie dotykające różnych dziedzin życia takich jak ekonomia, socjologia moda i wiele innych.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole Schalke 04

programme.title: Football - English league: Crystal Palace - Liverpool
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams begin the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. programme.title: American Football - NFL: Chicago Bears - Tampa Bay Buccaneers
programme.desc: The largest and most popular league of American football in the world, the NFL, was founded in 1920, but only by merging with the competing AFL in the middle of the last century, was the present version of the competition created. The league features 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best conference teams each enter the playoffs until the grand finale, popularly called the Super Bowl. The Super Bowl takes place at the beginning of February and is the most covered sports event on the planet.

programme.title: Bundesliga overview
programme.desc: Along with all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga also stands proudly. The highest rank of the football competition, founded in 1963, has 18 teams that start the race for the popular plate every August. It was won the most times by Bayern Munich, as many as 33 times. programme.title: Basketball - ABA league: Crvena zvezda - Slovan
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games each, against each other, one on the home field and one on the away field, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season.

The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Partizan - Baskonia
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league: Parma - UNICS
programme.desc: The VTB League brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia also participate in the league. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, other clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, of which the best placed becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank.
